title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_la_sed_harry_hole_11_by_jo_nesbo_pznny (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_la_sed_harry_hole_11_by_jo_nesbo_pznny' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, secure device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee full remediation due to potential persistent malicious software.
